objective: Test, not promise, net annual return > 500% with frequent BTC trades
data: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT 1m and realized funding; 2022-01-01 through 2026-07-31 UTC
original_exact_strategy: 10s trade flow, 5s stall, post-only entry, 15s TTL; requires trade/BBO event replay and is NOT equivalent to this screening
screening_proxy: 1m flow reversal and 1m stall; completed bars only; next-open taker entry and taker exits; pessimistic stop-first intrabar ordering

primary_costs.label: hypothetical OKX level-1 taker cost stress on Binance data, NOT an OKX backtest

diagnostic_zero_cost: Ablation only: commissions/slippage zero, realized funding retained; not deployable
diagnostic_controls: Disable daily/global halts only for edge measurement. Still risk-sized, single-position, no averaging, no leverage above 1x.
selection: Rank by minimum training calendar-year return after costs in diagnostic replay; deterministic config-id tie-break. Report diagnostic winner even when rejected. Admission requires positive returns in both training years and validation, at least 500 training trades, PF>=1.1 in training/validation; final never used to choose parameters.
aggressive_sensitivity: Only frozen diagnostic winner; risk 0.5%, max notional 3x, daily stop 2%, drawdown halt 25%; simulated sensitivity only, margin/liquidation not certified.
target_acceptance: 2025 full-year net >500%, OOS CAGR >500%, OOS max DD <=25%, >=20 trades/calendar day, positive stressed execution, actual same-venue tick/queue validation. Missing any required evidence means target_achieved=false and live_ready=false.
annual_reporting: Full calendar-year actual returns, 2026 YTD actual return, no short-window annualization. Original proxy first control column. Fresh per-year accounts are labeled separately from continuous OOS replay.
